about: The venue map document's schema file, spec 1 (spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2, AC-37, DC-1; plan/OA-1-map-document.md 1.0 section 5). One venue map document per venue (L170 Q1): the site, its buildings and levels, each level's elements, and the venue's connectors, in one venue frame (x across, z down the plan, origin top-left, metres; Q5). Read by functions/src/config/venueMapSchema.js, which checks this file's shape and freezes it; the Node validator (functions/src/services/venueMap/) takes every range, length, default and cap from here, so none is written twice. A Dart copy is generated from it into app/lib/core/config/ (AC-38), and the schema-forms lint's document mode checks map FieldSpecs against it (E-26, AC-40). Each constant names its source (AC-30); OA-3 changes a cap only from measured seeds (Q15). Field rules refer to constants by name. Closed sets live in closed-sets.json and are named here, never copied. The catalog and lookup rows are served, never copied (AC-38).

metres.source: office section 3 (every stored number rounded to the millimetre); spec section 2, AC-13

degrees.source: office section 3 (rot in degrees clockwise, normalised to [0, 360)); spec section 2, AC-13, AC-15

ratio.source: spec section 2.5.2 (an opening's at, rounded to 0.001), AC-13 (opacity to 3 decimals)

mpp.source: office section 3 (a backdrop's mpp is rounded to 7 decimals, not 3); spec section 2.5.9, AC-13, AC-14

latLon.source: spec section 2.2, AC-13, DC-31 (lat and lon rounded to 7 decimals)

spec.note: spec section 2.1: must be 1; another value is spec section 3.8's (readMap, AC-36)

units.note: spec section 2.1: absent or m; written as m

catalog.note: spec section 2.1 (section 10 Q2 ruled (b)): at most the context's catalog version; absent means the context's catalog version

georeference.note: spec section 2.2, AC-13a: null, or { origin: { lat, lon }, bearingDeg }; EC-4b: kept as null

mapUp.note: spec section 2.3: absent means the site's mapUp

building.note: spec section 2.4, AC-5 (B7): required on an indoor level, refused on the outdoor level

outdoor.note: spec section 2.4, AC-5 (B7): at most one outdoor level; its ordinal is 0

ordinal.note: spec section 2.4, AC-5 (B7): distinct among the levels of one building

origin.note: spec section 2.4, AC-6: with size, the rectangle lies inside [VENUE_EXTENT_MIN_M, VENUE_EXTENT_MAX_M]

size.note: spec section 2.4: [w, d], each coordinate in the range

b.note: spec section 2.5.1, AC-8: the wall from a to b is at least WALL_MIN_LENGTH_M long

w.note: spec section 2.5.2, AC-8: no longer than its wall (EC-31: its span may run past the wall's end)

clearW.note: spec section 2.5.2, AC-8: no more than w; absent means not measured

walkable.note: spec section 2.5.3, AC-9: when absent, true exactly when the category is in WalkableUnitCategory (P0-11 DC-8); always written

parent.note: spec section 2.5.3, AC-4: no unit is its own ancestor

floor.note: spec section 2.5.3: overrides the level's floor; absent means the level's

w.note: spec section 2.5.4, AC-8: only inside the type's resize range for w; required (above SIZE_MIN_EXCLUSIVE_M, at most the level's larger side) when the type has no default w (G13); absent means the type's default

d.note: spec section 2.5.4, AC-8: as w; never sent for a round type (d follows w)

id.note: spec section 2.5.9: the upload key, not an element id; that the file exists is OA-2's check

type.note: spec section 2.6, AC-7, DC-6: the code's CostModel is the one its kind names here

levels.note: spec section 2.6, AC-7: an escalator runs levels[0] to levels[1]

stops.note: spec section 2.6, AC-7, DC-5: one point per entry of levels, in the same order, each inside that level

w.note: spec section 2.6, DC-7: a ramp's w is at most the larger side of the smallest level it serves

len.note: spec section 2.6, DC-7: a ramp's len is at most the larger side of the smallest level it serves

twoWay.note: N6 (a Gabay-only field): true means the escalator runs both ways; stairs, ramps and elevators are always two-way

walkable.note: office section 4.2: false means scenery, never used

evacuationOnly.note: L87, DC-18, AC-7: not allowed together with walkable false

exportFile.source: office section 8.7, adapted; spec AC-47, DC-23; L170 Q11 (b) (geometry plus stores); spec section 10 Q5 ruled (a) (no status, no active flag)

map.note: spec AC-47: a canonical document passed through publishable(), so it holds no backdrop

stores.note: spec AC-47: no two stores share a unit key (P0-11 G7), so there are at most as many stores as units

unit.note: spec AC-47: the key of a unit of the envelope's map
